department: School of Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline with supporting documents is January 31, 2027 (January intake: July 31).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for materials science and engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: NTU strongly recommends contacting a potential supervisor before applying; otherwise the School assigns a supervisor based on research interests.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended that you seek out a potential supervisor prior to submitting your application. Alternatively, if you have not identified one, the School will appoint a supervisor based on your research interests.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a relevant bachelor's degree with at least 2nd Upper Honours (1st Class Honours required for universities in India; 80+ average for China).
entry_route.quote: Applicants from overseas universities must have a relevant Bachelor’s degree with at least 2nd Upper Honours or better. | Applicants from universities in India must have 1st Class Honours for the relevant Bachelor’s degree.

toefl_min.value: MSE requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100 iBT (250 CBT / 600 PBT) within 2 years unless waived via English MOI documentation.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL score must be equivalent to or more than: | 100 for internet-based test

ielts_min.value: MSE requires a minimum IELTS score of 6.5 within 2 years unless waived via English MOI documentation.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS score must be equivalent to or more than 6.5.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS may be waived if the applicant provides documentary proof (letter or certificate) that English was the medium of instruction during tertiary studies.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL/IELTS requirements may be waived if the applicant can prove that English was used as the medium of instruction during tertiary studies. The documentary proof is usually in a form of a letter or certificate.

notes: MSE specifies 1st Class Honours for Indian bachelor's applicants, TOEFL >= 100 iBT / IELTS >= 6.5, and requires at least one accepted first-author/co-first-author publication before PhD thesis submission.
